_note: Consolidated segment data, Rs crore. IOC reports four segments from FY25 (petroleum products; petrochemicals; gas; other business = E&P, explosives & cryogenics, wind and solar). Up to FY24 gas sat inside 'other business', so we combine gas and other into one segment ('Gas & other') for a consistent FY21-FY26 history. Segment EBITDA = segment result before exchange gain/loss + segment depreciation & amortisation. Segment revenue is external revenue; excise duty (the gap between external revenue and Screener's net sales) is taken out of petroleum products, so the segments add up to Screener's net sales. 'Unallocated' = Screener operating profit (EBITDA) less the sum of segment EBITDA: almost all of it is exchange losses (segmental and unallocable) and derivative losses. IOC does not split petroleum products into refining, marketing and pipelines.
